title: list_queries input
description: The tool catalog (every query, its schemas, whether it pages or spans a workspace, and whether it reads or manages), the contract manifest (the version of every public contract this server speaks) and the newest query records of this data directory: tool, repository, snapshot, time, duration, truncation and the hash of the input. Inputs and results are never stored.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered; also filters the records.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.
